lines.l: From the pain you drive into the heart of me
The love we share seems to go nowhere
For I toss and turn, I can't sleep at night
Once I ran to you, now I'll run from you
I give you all a boy could give you
Take my tears and that's not nearly all
Now I know I've got to run away
You don't really want any more from me
You need someone to hold you tight
And you think love is to pray
But I'm sorry I don't pray that way
I give you all a boy could give you
Take my tears and that's not nearly all
Oh, tainted love, oh, tainted love
I cannot stand the way you tease
I love you, though you hurt me so
Now I'm gonna pack my things and go
Baby, baby, where did our love go?
Oh, don't you leave me, don't you leave me no more
I've got this burning, yawning, yawning feeling inside me
So tingly with the burning love
Don't you leave me no more
Oh, baby, baby, where did I not go?
Oh, don't you leave me, don't you leave me no more
